external_dependencies.name: CPython interpreter
external_dependencies.scope: Full offline wheel set targets CPython 3.14 Windows AMD64. Interpreter itself is supplied by the target computer.

external_dependencies.name: Aspen Plus / EDR / SW6 and licenses
external_dependencies.scope: Actual simulation, equipment rating and mechanical calculations require licensed installed engineering software; no real engineering-software acceptance is claimed by this release.

external_dependencies.name: Model host
external_dependencies.scope: CLI needs no remote model. MCP requires a compatible host; local tool execution does not imply offline language-model inference.

external_dependencies.name: Project authority and exact model evidence
external_dependencies.scope: Current project values, protected models, vendors, quotations and exact-run evidence are supplied separately; no historical project values are defaults.

external_dependencies.name: Full textbook/help/source documents and private historical cases
external_dependencies.scope: Reviewed structured knowledge and equipment facts are bundled; full copyrighted pages, private models and source-build project profiles are not redistributed.

external_dependencies.name: Source-maintenance and report tool dependencies
external_dependencies.scope: OCR, PDF/Word extraction, plotting, report compilation and project-specific cost tools may require their declared libraries, original sources or software beyond the bundled MCP/NumPy runtime.

external_dependencies.name: Project cost datasets
external_dependencies.scope: Generic cost source/mapping tools are retained; validated licensed cost tables and project recipes must be provided explicitly.
